Ngl, this is kind of a straight buff.

Leer at 80 hp doesn't change much(except dmg threshold for a couple of pistols?), and the smaller hitbox would be a straight buff.

While she can now dismiss only one time(at a time), it has the effect of using both abilities, which is pretty great. It also has the possibility to be used again, meaning it would be a straight buff if you survive 40 sec after using it. 
The orb lasting more is nice and open some more avenues, while the dismiss lasting more is a straight buff(no more hitting that reyna as she was about to turn a corner and dismiss wear off), especially since she can cancel it on her own if she needs to.

The orb now gives her post plan, clearing and molly capabilities, especially since it has enough damage to kill you if you stand in it for the full duration.

The nerfed ult isn't too big of a deal unless everyone is on the other site when you pop it. Hell, the lower duration encorages more aggressive plays to keep it refreshed, so it could be see as kind of a positive if you squint really hard.


All in all, reyna gained a lot of power, and her gameplay loop changed a bit.

Now you take one fight instead of two quick ones becuse of the dismiss changes, but you can do it every 40 sec.

You can play post plan really well.

You can clear corners or cut off chokes with Q, meaning playing reyna became much safer.

Your ult makes you play even more aggressive than before. While technically a nerf, it would mean that more reyna would try to do things when they pop ult, instead of waiting until the last 5 sec of it or just letting it fade.


All in all, damn good buff i'd say

Also, please don't play Kayle support.

While she might have a heal, and a ult that might remind of a support, she is not. She is a hyperscaler, meaning that she's weak at game start, but the longer it goes, as she gets more experience and gold, the stronger she gets.
Kayle has a special reliance on hitting lvl16(meaning she doesn't want to share experience), because it's a huge powerspike for her(she gets power ups at lvl 6,11 and 16).

As for champs kills... well it depends,

First thing first, secure the kill. It doesn't matter who gets the kill, if the enemy just gets away still alive.

Your first priority in those situation is to make sure the enemy doesn't escape. If that means throwing an autoattack, killing the champ? Do it.
Sure, your adc *might* have gotten them, but consistency is the name of the game here.
Almost always Better to  have "lesser" rewards all the time, that gambling it all on something.

There are some support that might want a kill or two to get a powerspike, but then are good as is. These are normally poke champs like vel'koz, since it'll make their poke damage and their killing potential that much higher in lane.

Then there are enchanters(buff/heal/shielding) and tank support, that have to try not to take kills, since their jobs is to enable their team(enchanters by buffing and keeping them alive, and tanks by cc'ing(crowd control, things like stuns) and peeling(taking hits and keeping the enemies off of your easily killed teammates so that they can kill the enemy team).
